description:
Connect to user's existing Chrome/Chromium browser for human-in-the-loop automation (CAPTCHAs, login); the user starts it with --remote-debugging-port=

--user-data-dir=

. Accepts a CDP port, ws:// URL, or '--auto' (scans DevToolsActivePort); requires 127.0.0.1/localhost. Registered as external: cdpilot never closes, kills, or injects into it (browser_close only disconnects). chrome://inspect is not supported (exit 2).

target.description: CDP port number, ws:// URL, or '--auto' to auto-detect.

name: browser_connect
